chosenApproach: Retain canonical original three-act structure, remove after-story classroom Q&A, preserve direct Scripture-grounded dialogue, replace seven key scenes, and integrate a unique editor-authored event paragraph for each of the other 125 Bible episodes. Add 132 complete editorial source records, bilingual Jest and Node contracts, and preserve offline TTS, prayer, discussion, quiz and account progress.
selectionRationale: A source-only change to the 132 Bible lesson assembly automatically updates both the full reader and existing TTS without new dependencies; each Scripture reference now has a unique canonical-event paragraph and no generic teacher/class conversations.
alternativeApproaches: Leave the epilogue but rename it as a teaching question: rejected because the teacher conversation would still interrupt the requested Bible story and audio.
Automate fabricated dialogue for every biblical figure: rejected because fictional quotations misrepresent the Scripture.
Refactor the shared story reader and speech engine: rejected due unrelated runtime and performance regression risk.
